Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: How Vanderbilt pays exempt (monthly) staff working in NY, CA, and other states; Which Vanderbilt roles count as manual workers in NY; Whether a newer DOL State Payday Requirements table than 2021 exists; Whether Vanderbilt uses weekly or biweekly pay groups for non-exempt staff outside TN.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Each state sets how often employees must be paid. Vanderbilt pays exempt staff monthly and non-exempt staff weekly or biweekly, and some states set different minimums.

If you hire outside Tennessee, check the state's pay frequency rule before the offer so the person lands on a pay schedule the state allows.

Use this whenYou are hiring or moving someone who will work outside Tennessee.

2 · Walk through

How to check.

Check off each item as you read.

Examples (confirm with payroll)
StateGeneral rule
New York, manual workersWeekly (non-profit: at least semimonthly)
New York, clerical and otherAt least semimonthly
CaliforniaAt least twice a month

Watch-outs

  • The DOL table is a summary and may lag changes in state law. Check the state's own site.
  • Open item: confirm with your engagement consultant (EC) and payroll how Vanderbilt pays exempt (monthly) staff working in New York, California, and other states.
  • Open item: confirm with your EC which Vanderbilt roles count as manual workers in New York.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Regional and Out-of-State Hiring

Payroll cadence

Use when: You are hiring or moving someone who will work outside Tennessee. · System: Overview

  1. Look up the state in the DOL payday table.
  2. New York: watch for manual workers.
  3. California: twice a month is the base rule.
  4. Compare the state rule with the person's pay group.
  5. Make sure the location is right in Oracle.
Examples (confirm with payroll)
StateGeneral rule
New York, manual workersWeekly (non-profit: at least semimonthly)
New York, clerical and otherAt least semimonthly
CaliforniaAt least twice a month

Watch-outs

  • The DOL table is a summary and may lag changes in state law. Check the state's own site.
  • Open item: confirm with your engagement consultant (EC) and payroll how Vanderbilt pays exempt (monthly) staff working in New York, California, and other states.
  • Open item: confirm with your EC which Vanderbilt roles count as manual workers in New York.
